summary: The note describes the Acura RLX, a full-size luxury sedan made by Honda for its Acura division and released in 2013 as the successor to the Acura RL. It comes in two versions: a front-wheel drive base model with Precision All-Wheel Steer four-wheel steering, and a hybrid SH-AWD variant that serves as Acura's flagship. The Japanese domestic market version, the Honda Legend, is offered only with the SH-AWD powertrain.
one_line: The Acura RLX is Honda's 2013 full-size luxury sedan for the Acura division, succeeding the RL, with base and SH-AWD hybrid versions.
key_facts: The Acura RLX is a full-size luxury sedan manufactured by Honda and sold under its Acura division.
The Acura RLX was released in 2013.
The Acura RLX succeeded the Acura RL.
The base model of the Acura RLX is front-wheel drive.
The base model of the Acura RLX is equipped with Acura's Precision All-Wheel Steer (P-AWS) four-wheel steering system.
The hybrid variant of the Acura RLX features SH-AWD.
The hybrid variant of the Acura RLX serves as Acura's flagship.
The JDM version of the Acura RLX is the Honda Legend.
The Honda Legend is only offered with the SH-AWD powertrain.
